newsitem.title: USA: Burlington sets IC track use.
newsitem.headline: Burlington sets IC track use.

text.p: Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp said it and Illinois Central Corp have signed a letter of intent for a long-term haulage agreement between Memphis, Tenn., and Effingham, Ill.

Under the agreement, Illinois Central provides power, fuel and crews in return for a per-car fee from Burlington, the railroad said. In addition, the agreement will include volume-based haulage between New Orleans and Memphis and between Memphis and Chicago, as well as switching agreements at Chicago and New Orleans.

Further, the agreement provides overhead trackage rights for Burlington over IC track between Portage, Ill., and Chicago, as well as allowing Burlington to move cars over IC's connection between Burlington's Corwith and Cicero yards.

"With this agreement, we can provide improved levels of service -- both consistency and shorter transit times -- between the Texas Gulf and the Northeast region, adding to our competitiveness," said Burlington.
The agreement is expected to become effective during the fourth quarter 1996 upon completion of a definitive agreement.
